about: Class of every Lygos change on top of anchorageoss/visualsign-parser. FORK-PATCHES.json is append-only (lygos/check-fork-patches.mjs), so its upstreamCandidate flags cannot be corrected in place; this file records the class instead and does not replace the manifest. A = generic, upstream-ready. B = ours, upstreamable only behind caller configuration. C = Lygos-only, belongs in our wrapper. D = build, packaging, wasm glue, our checks.
